newsitem.title: USA: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 23.
newsitem.headline: N.Y. Fed Press Briefing - January 23.

text.p: The Federal Reserve said it had no large one day net misses in its reserve projections in the latest week, a Fed spokeswoman said.
The high in natural float was about $2.7 billion on Tuesday, while the low was about $500 million on Friday.
Transportation float averaged a bit under $100 million per day, with the high on Tuesday at about $375 million, primarily due to scattered weather and de-icing delays in Chicago.
